candidates.angle: Krishna asks Arjuna to direct his mind, devotion, worship, and bowing toward him
candidates.evidence: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु । मामेवैष्यसि युक्त्वैवमात्मानं मत्परायणः ॥

candidates.angle: He names four actions that all lead to him alone
candidates.evidence: मन्मना (mind on me), मद्भक्तः (my devotee), मद्याजी (my worshipper), माम् (to me)

candidates.angle: He promises that this full orientation will bring Arjuna to him
candidates.evidence: मामएवैष्यसि (you will come to me only)

angle_en: Four actions, one promise to him
angle_hi: चार काम, एक वादा सिर्फ मुझे तक

en.intro: Krishna asks Arjuna to direct four different actions toward him, and promises that this will bring Arjuna to him. Listen for how these four actions connect.
en.notice: Krishna names four actions: fixing the mind, becoming a devotee, worshipping, and bowing. He then gives one promise that unites all four, showing that the entire path leads to him alone.
en.next: Krishna opens the next chapter by promising a supreme word spoken for Arjuna's welfare because Arjuna is deeply dear to him.
en.meaning: Fix your mind on me. Be devoted to me. Worship me. Bow to me. United with me in this way, and fully oriented toward me, you will come to me.

hi.intro: कृष्ण अर्जुन से चार काम करने को कहते हैं जो सीधे उन्हें ही करने हैं, और एक वादा करते हैं कि यह सब उन्हें तक ले जाएगा। ध्यान से सुनिए कि ये चार काम कैसे जुड़ते हैं।
hi.meaning: कृष्ण कहते हैं, तू मेरा भक्त हो जा, मेरेमें मनवाला हो जा, मेरा पूजन करनेवाला हो जा और मेरेको नमस्कार कर। इस प्रकार मेरे साथ अपने आपको लगाकर, मेरे परायण हुआ तू मेरेको ही प्राप्त होगा।
hi.notice: कृष्ण चार काम बताते हैं, मन को मुझमें लगाना, मेरा भक्त बनना, मेरी पूजा करना और मुझे प्रणाम करना। फिर वे एक वादा करते हैं जो इन सबको जोड़ देता है, यह दिखाते हुए कि यह पूरा रास्ता सिर्फ मुझे तक ले जाता है।
hi.next: कृष्ण अगले अध्याय में एक श्रेष्ठ वचन सुनाते हैं जो वे अर्जुन की भलाई के लिए कहते हैं।

en.intro: Krishna asks Arjuna to direct four different actions toward him, and promises that this will bring Arjuna to him. Listen for how these four actions connect.

Krishna names four actions: fixing the mind, becoming a devotee, worshipping, and bowing. He then gives one promise that unites all four, showing that the entire path leads to him alone. Krishna opens the next chapter by promising a supreme word spoken for Arjuna's welfare because Arjuna is deeply dear to him.
